name: How much does it cost to install drywall in a basement?

mainEntity.name: How much does it cost to install drywall in a basement?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost of basement drywall installation varies significantly based on several factors, including the size of the basement, the type of drywall selected (e.g., moisture-resistant), ceiling height, and any necessary framing or insulation work. Prices generally range from $1.50 to $3.00 per square foot for materials and labor. For an accurate estimate in areas like Pacifica or San Bruno, a professional consultation is essential to assess your specific project requirements.
acceptedAnswer.description: Costs vary, typically $1.50-$3.00 per square foot, depending on basement size, drywall type, and labor in your Bay Area location.
